Weremantis Guard (Giant Mantis Form) CR 4

Towering a foot above him, the insect looks like it could easily sever the elf’s head with a single swipe of its barbed arms, but its clacking mandibles are somehow even more inhumanly frightening.

LE Medium vermin (human, shapechanger)

Female kavbroed weremantids cannot train or control male kavraen, but are adept at using weapons and their greater size to prod males to move in particular directions or attack particular targets.

Mandibles (Ex)
